reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the proposal correctly carries no redline and no counterparty comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

Cited text supports compliance: p0028 uses 'non-exclusive' only to limit the scope of the licence granted to Sparkling (a benefit-neutral scope limitation, not a purchasing covenant), and p0084 imposes only a fee-payment obligation with no requirements or sole-source commitment.

Per detection guidance, exclusive-remedy, non-exclusive escrow licence and non-exclusive jurisdiction references are not exclusive-dealing obligations, so the rationale's dismissal of them is accurate.
Deterministic check confirms no residual requirements/sole-supplier obligation binding Customer; rendered text is unchanged from the original, as expected.
